content.text: {"openings":[{"text":"Mira spread her arms at the moonlit pond. “Tonight, we make the grandest concert ever!” Tom hugged the silver kettle-drum. “Grandest—and I win the Golden Tadpole Spoon.” Pip tucked a paper invitation under one green toe. He hoped Nella would hear his little moon-song.","when":[]},{"text":"The floating stage bobbed beside the bank while Mira planned glittering cheers, Tom polished his drumsticks, and Pip whispered, “A quiet song for Nella.” Nobody yet knew whether Nella was behind the cattails or away.","when":[{"key":"nella.presence","op":"eq","value":"cattails","at":"initial"}]},{"text":"The floating stage bobbed beside the bank while Mira planned glittering cheers, Tom polished his drumsticks, and Pip whispered, “A quiet song for Nella.” But Nella was away, so Pip’s invitation waited like a tiny folded boat.","when":[{"key":"nella.presence","op":"eq","value":"away","at":"initial"}]}],"scenes":[{"scene":"look_nella","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Mira peered through the cattails. “Nella? Are you hiding, or are you practicing being a cattail?” At once, she discovered whether Nella was there or away.","when":[{"key":"mira.knows.nella.presence","op":"ne","value":null,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"notice_quiet","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip pressed one toe to the mud and listened. Behind the cattails, he discovered that Nella’s hearing was keen. “Then even a whisper can be a concert,” he said.","when":[{"key":"pip.knows.nella.hearing","op":"eq","value":"keen","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Pip listened closely and discovered that Nella’s hearing was muffled. He lowered his voice until it sounded like a beetle wearing slippers.","when":[{"key":"pip.knows.nella.hearing","op":"eq","value":"muffled","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_tom_hearing","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip leaned toward Tom. “Nella can hear keenly,” he whispered. Tom’s drumstick froze halfway to the sky. “Keenly?”","when":[{"key":"tom.knows.nella.hearing","op":"eq","value":"keen","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Pip leaned toward Tom. “Nella’s hearing is muffled,” he whispered. Tom nodded, then whispered even louder, which was not the same thing.","when":[{"key":"tom.knows.nella.hearing","op":"eq","value":"muffled","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"tell_tom_wish","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"“I want to play the moon-song for Nella,” Pip told Tom. “It has three soft notes and one enormous feeling.” Tom looked at the drum, which suddenly seemed very enormous too.","when":[{"key":"tom.knows.pip.wish","op":"eq","value":"moon_song","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"invite_nella","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Pip sent the paper invitation sliding through the cattails, where it landed with a polite little plop.","when":[{"key":"invitation.owner","op":"eq","value":"nella","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"accept_invitation","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"A hand appeared between the cattails and accepted the invitation. Nella did not step out yet, but one bright eye peeked toward the pond.","when":[{"key":"nella.invited","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"float_stage","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Mira and Pip pushed the reed stage onto the pond. It floated proudly, though one corner wiggled like a ticklish duck.","when":[{"key":"reedstage.location","op":"eq","value":"pond","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"hang_lanterns","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"Mira draped the lantern ribbon across the stage. The lights blinked on, making the pond look sprinkled with tiny moons.","when":[{"key":"lanterns.location","op":"eq","value":"reedstage","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"rehearse_roar","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tom thumped the kettle-drum. BOOM! Three frogs leaped, one frog applauded, and a lily pad put both hands over its face. “That,” said Tom, “was only my polite finale.”","when":[{"key":"concert.rehearsal","op":"eq","value":"roar","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"rehearse_ripple","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tom practiced a clever ripple: tap-tap, rumble, BOOM. “It begins like a raindrop,” he announced, “and ends like a hippo sneezing.”","when":[{"key":"concert.rehearsal","op":"eq","value":"roar","at":"after"},{"key":"tom.plan","op":"eq","value":"clever","at":"before"}]}]},{"scene":"rehearse_moon","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip sang his moon-song on the floating stage. The notes curled over the water, and even the lantern ribbon seemed to lean closer.","when":[{"key":"concert.rehearsal","op":"eq","value":"moon","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"choose_kind_finale","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tom looked at Pip, then at the drum. “All right,” he said. “Your moon-song first. I’ll make my finale small enough to fit in a frog’s pocket.” Pip beamed; Tom’s drumstick gave a brave little salute.","when":[{"key":"tom.agrees","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"call_concert_away","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"With Nella away, Mira called across the pond, “Frogs, fireflies, and anyone carrying a snack—the concert is beginning!”","when":[{"key":"concert.started","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"},{"key":"nella.presence","op":"eq","value":"away","at":"before"}]}]},{"scene":"call_concert_guest","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"The invitation fluttered, the lanterns glowed, and Mira called, “Welcome to the pond concert!” From the cattails came a pleased rustle.","when":[{"key":"concert.started","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"perform_roar","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Tom struck the finale. BOOM-BOOM-BOOM! Frogs cheered, lily pads bounced, and Tom grinned so widely that his ears nearly became parentheses.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"loud","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"perform_moon","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip sang the moon-song. His voice slipped between the reeds like silver thread. Nobody shouted over it. Even Tom held his drumstick still.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"soft","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"perform_mixed","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"Pip’s moon-song floated first. Then Tom added a playful ripple—tap, tap, wobble, BOOM! The frogs cheered for both sounds, and the stage bobbed like it was laughing.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"mixed","at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"award_spoon_loud","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"The frogs presented Tom with the Golden Tadpole Spoon. He lifted it high; it wobbled in the moonlight like a very tiny trophy moon.","when":[{"key":"spoon.owner","op":"eq","value":"tom","at":"after"},{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"loud","at":"before"}]}]},{"scene":"award_spoon_mixed","role":"beat","variants":[{"text":"For the concert’s two-part sparkle, the frogs gave Tom the Golden Tadpole Spoon. He shared its shine with Pip by tilting it between them.","when":[{"key":"spoon.owner","op":"eq","value":"tom","at":"after"},{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"mixed","at":"before"}]}]},{"scene":"close_loud","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"The drum’s last boom rolled away, and Tom tucked the wobbling spoon beside his heart.","when":[{"key":"concert.finished","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"close_soft","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"The moon-song ended. For one lovely moment, the pond kept the final note all by itself.","when":[{"key":"concert.finished","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]},{"scene":"close_mixed","role":"bridge","variants":[{"text":"The cheers faded into chuckles as the reed stage settled beneath its lanterns.","when":[{"key":"concert.finished","op":"eq","value":true,"at":"after"}]}]}],"endings":[{"text":"Tom held up the Golden Tadpole Spoon while the frogs cheered. It wobbled like a tiny brass moon above the booming pond.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"loud","at":"after"},{"key":"spoon.owner","op":"eq","value":"tom","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The last drumbeat bounced off the lily pads, and Tom’s Golden Tadpole Spoon flashed brighter than the fireflies.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"loud","at":"after"},{"key":"spoon.owner","op":"eq","value":"tom","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Nella stepped from the cattails as Pip’s moon-song faded. One lantern glimmered beside her still, smiling face.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"soft","at":"after"},{"key":"nella.presence","op":"eq","value":"cattails","at":"after"}]},{"text":"Pip’s final note rested on the water. Beside the cattails, Nella smiled, and a single lantern made a gold path toward her.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"soft","at":"after"},{"key":"nella.presence","op":"eq","value":"cattails","at":"after"}]},{"text":"The mixed concert left the stage wearing both a curled cattail and Tom’s shining Golden Tadpole Spoon, as if the pond had dressed for a party.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"mixed","at":"after"},{"key":"spoon.owner","op":"eq","value":"tom","at":"after"}]},{"text":"A soft song and a silly drum ripple twinkled together. On the reed stage, the spoon shone beside a curled cattail.","when":[{"key":"concert.style","op":"eq","value":"mixed","at":"after"},{"key":"spoon.owner","op":"eq","value":"tom","at":"after"}]}],"lexicon":[]}
